# Neural Amp Modeler core

Inference for `.nam` amp and pedal profiles (A1 and A2 architectures, slimmable containers).

| Part | Source | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAM/`, `LICENSE` | [sdatkinson/NeuralAmpModelerCore](https://github.com/sdatkinson/NeuralAmpModelerCore) | v0.6.0 (`0b3d3c97b0859a3a8c92a8628c4dd89a25eb5842`) | MIT |
| `Dependencies/eigen/` | [Eigen](https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen), submodule of the above: `Eigen/` and `unsupported/Eigen/FFT` only | 5.0.1 (`bc3b39870ecb690a623a3f49149a358b95c5781d`) | MPL-2.0, some files BSD/Apache-2.0/MINPACK (`COPYING.*`) |
| `Dependencies/nlohmann/json.hpp` | [nlohmann/json](https://github.com/nlohmann/json) single include, as shipped with the above | 3.12.0 | MIT |

Copied unmodified. To update, check out a tagged NeuralAmpModelerCore release with submodules, copy the same paths,
run the native tests and update this table and `licenses/`.
